description: This file implements the SetCaps class for configuring audio capabilities in a WebAudio context, including building GStreamer caps for raw audio data and setting properties like bytes per sample.

classes.name: WebAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Abstract base class for building WebAudio GStreamer caps.

classes.name: WebAudioPcmCapsBuilder
classes.description: Concrete implementation of WebAudioCapsBuilder for PCM audio configuration.

classes.name: SetCaps
classes.description: Class responsible for setting GStreamer caps for WebAudio playback based on MIME type and configuration.

methods.name: SetCaps
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetCaps object with context, wrappers, MIME type, and configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to create and set GStreamer caps on the app source, and update bytes per sample.

methods.name: createCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates GstCaps based on the MIME type, using appropriate builder.

methods.name: setBytesPerSample
methods.description: Calculates and sets the bytes per sample in the context based on PCM configuration.
